targets.queryText: WITH ranked_days AS (SELECT game_day, day_meta_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY game_day ORDER BY imported_at DESC) AS rn FROM gameplay_days WHERE user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}), event_types AS (SELECT game_day, group_concat(event_type, '、') AS event_types FROM (SELECT DISTINCT game_day, event_type FROM gameplay_events WHERE user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY event_type) GROUP BY game_day) SELECT rd.game_day AS 日期, rd.day_meta_json AS metadata, COALESCE(et.event_types, '-') AS event_type FROM ranked_days rd LEFT JOIN event_types et ON et.game_day = rd.game_day WHERE rd.rn = 1 ORDER BY rd.game_day ASC
targets.rawQueryText: WITH ranked_days AS (SELECT game_day, day_meta_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY game_day ORDER BY imported_at DESC) AS rn FROM gameplay_days WHERE user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}), event_types AS (SELECT game_day, group_concat(event_type, '、') AS event_types FROM (SELECT DISTINCT game_day, event_type FROM gameplay_events WHERE user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY event_type) GROUP BY game_day) SELECT rd.game_day AS 日期, rd.day_meta_json AS metadata, COALESCE(et.event_types, '-') AS event_type FROM ranked_days rd LEFT JOIN event_types et ON et.game_day = rd.game_day WHERE rd.rn = 1 ORDER BY rd.game_day ASC
